name: Oriel
source:
Once the guardian of Heaven itself, Oriel now spends her days wandering the slums, looking for items to hoard for her excessive collection. 

After a few lifetimes down there, however, she finds the pool of resources sorely lacking...

[From [url=https://rosesrot.itch.io/seraphim-slum]itch.io[/url]]
